craft_notes: Sthāyin: not-inside-repeat (v94 returns with eye-pairs: the negation doubled — not-me-not-eye, ANYTHING-then-Bhairava: the apophasis ends in the positive everything). Sanskrit: na māntar mama kriyā...yugmadvayaṃ na dṛśyate...sarvaṃ bhairavam eva → L4 keeps not-me-not-eye line 1, anything-Bhairava line 2. Rows: row 2 (nothing-visioned→at-once-Bhairava). Close: thus (iti — the flat thus: Bhairava THIS WAY — no glory-word needed). Rejected: 'vision fails' — killed: nothing visioned kept (the object missing, not the eye); 'everything is God' — killed: Bhairava kept (the specific name is the verse's specificity).

lines: In me not inner-making; eye-pairs — nothing visioned:
at once — anything's Bhairava, Bhairava thus.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ahaṃ mamedam ityādi pratipattiprasaṅgataḥ | nirādhāre mano yāti taddhyānapreraṇāc chamī

reads_against.argmap: How does conviction free the mind? → Conviction removes I-mine; supportless mind falls into calm.
